title: Histone Methylation and Arginine Metabolism in Various Organisms
summary: This cluster is centered around histone methylation, a process catalyzed by Dot1 and Grappa, and involved in arginine methyltransferase and PRMT5. The cluster also includes various organisms, such as Kohl JB, Kodama Y, and Kuras L, which have been studied in relation to specific genes and processes, including H2S metabolism and sulfite oxidase deficiency. Additionally, arginine is stored in vacuoles, and methionine permease has been studied in relation to Kuras L.
